text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard her voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't count how many times all her silly
yelling
has cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But today, it terrified me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't anything working? Why can't
I...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Tic-ke-zo! Tic-ke-zo! Tic-ke-zo!
Tic-ke-zo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! I did it, I did it, I did it! I WON!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyone! I did it! I
really did
it!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on this huge win,
Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm so, so, so happy right
now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I poured my heart and soul into this race.
Winning
the Derby has been my dream
for so long, and I
trained as hard as I
could for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... I did it all for the sake of this victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And you did fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work even harder! I'm gonna
keep
giving my fans the most exciting
races possible!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support, everyone! I
hope
you'll continue to cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She's planning to become even faster
than that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If she does, then I'll... I'll...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but... I wasn't good enough—I
lost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still reeling from the loss and
remains silent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What can I say to make her feel better?
It reminds
me of before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide looks just as despondent
as she
did after the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders jump. It appears she does,
and her
current worries have some
connection to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Talk about rubbing salt in the wound...
choice_data_list: What have you been thinking about since then?
What have you been thinking about ever since then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about how I keep
losing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've lost twice now. Once to Taishin at
the Satsuki
Sho, and again to Ticket at
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We planned for so many scenarios and
tried to
anticipate so many variables. But
they just have
something I lack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whatever that something is, if it's not
simply an
oversight... If it's something I'm
intrinsically
missing, then beating them is
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: Then let's factor that "something" into the equation too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Where are you getting that confidence
from? I
don't have the foggiest idea
what it could be, so
how am I supposed
to solve for it?
choice_data_list: I'm sure Hayahide can work it into her routine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is extremely smart. Smart
enough
to figure out most things on her
own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's why she always tries to solve
everything alone,
even when facing an
insurmountable challenge.
But...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You can't be serious.
choice_data_list: Let's try it for now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: If we run enough tests, we might find the answer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You really think I can find the right
answer by
repeatedly testing a baseless
calculation?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's absolutely absurd. Not only does
it make
no sense, it's completely
illogical.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Only someone utterly desperate to solve
an
equation would try something like
that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You know me too well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stay and talk in the waiting room for
a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We speak about why Biwa Hayahide
suddenly
feels such a gap between
herself and her two
rivals, and what she
can do about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've identified what our priority should
be based
on our discussion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Equipping me with the iron will to
improve. I need
you to think back for a
second.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race. She was
amazing. I want
to win harder than ever,
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I poured my heart and soul into this race.
Winning
the Derby has been my dream
for so long, and I
trained as hard as I
could for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My hypothesis is that Ticket and
Taishin's
willingness to do whatever it
takes to win is the
source of their drive
and determination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good. I have a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Going forward, don't be afraid to push me to my limits. In fact, I want you to make me work harder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure. I don't ever want to taste
defeat again,
and to ensure that I don't,
I need to push myself
harder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She starts running again, this time with a
new
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't ever lose again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a determination bordering
on
obsession...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide sets her sights on the
final race of
the Classic Triple Crown
tour—the Kikuka Sho.
